{{Short description|none}}
The '''[[Quebec Nordiques]]''' were an [[ice hockey]] team who played in both the [[National Hockey League]] (NHL) and the [[World Hockey Association]] (WHA). This is a list of the head coaches they had during their existence. The franchise moved to [[Denver, Colorado|Denver]], [[Colorado]], in 1995, and became the [[Colorado Avalanche]].

[[Michel Bergeron (hockey coach)|Michel Bergeron]] coached the most games and won the most points all-time with the Nordiques, with 634 games and 616 points. [[Maurice Filion]] and Michel Bergeron were the only coaches to have three terms with the Nordiques. [[Marc Crawford]] was the only Nordiques coach to win the [[Jack Adams Award]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nhl.com/trophies/adams.html|title=Jack Adams Award|accessdate=2008-05-13|publisher=Lincoln Hockey and the National Hockey League|work=NHL.com|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20080706102444/http://www.nhl.com/trophies/adams.html|archivedate=2008-07-06}}</ref>

==Notes==
